Disc image (.iso/.xex) files cannot be played directly. Select the folder extracted from the disc (it contains a media folder) — the same one the Windows launcher uses.
Select the folder extracted from your game disc (the one containing media/ui). It stays where it is and is read in place. Internal storage gives the best streaming speed.
